serve: bash scripts/serve.sh 8080, MLX_VLM_TOKEN_QUEUE_TIMEOUT=3600, draft on, default TK=4

subsets.gsm8k: openai/gsm8k main test, random 200 of 1319, seed 20261123
subsets.gpqa_diamond: Idavidrein/gpqa gpqa_diamond, full set (198); choices shuffled per item with seed
subsets.aime2025: math-ai/aime25 test, full set (30), not subsampled

scoring.gsm8k: numeric equality after extracting #### / \boxed{} / last number from the assistant content (not the reasoning trace)
scoring.mmlu_pro: letter A-J extracted from assistant content
scoring.gpqa_diamond: letter A-D extracted from assistant content
scoring.aime2025: integer 0-999 from \boxed{} or answer line in assistant content

hf_model_card.note: The official card table does not report GSM8K, MMLU-Pro, GPQA Diamond, or AIME 2025, so no card scores are cited.
